firstPlayerRule: The youngest player holds the first auction, choosing a painting from their hand to offer for sale.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are tied, choose randomly among them.
clarifications: The Auctioneer passes the Hammer token left after a painting is sold. The opening bidder and bidding order depend on the auction type.
